Equipment
 Excitation System of Gas
 Turbine Generator
 660/1650R

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for gas Turbine Generator 
 excitation system, which must be performed on every yearly bases as indicated 
 by Y1 in the title block or during any stoppage.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Fouad, tested by eng. Wagih Khalil, revised by 
 MDEPC quality 
 control eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran and approved by 
 eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd 
El Gillil MDEPC quality control general manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Nageb inspection and quality control head sector.

items: A work permit must be issued.

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
Check power supply for each panel
Measure the insulation resistance of control and alarm circuit.
Retighten the wiring and general cleaning by blower with small pressure.
Clean the bars and check coil by blower.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for gas Turbine Generator 
 excitation system, which must be performed on every yearly bases as indicated 
 by Y1 in the title block or during any stoppage.
Technical Specifications:
Power Circuit / Auxiliary Supply
1607 ADC
(Secondary voltage of excitation transformer)
2x 24 VDC, 1 A continuous

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Fouad, tested by eng. Wagih Khalil, revised by 
 MDEPC quality 
 control eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran and approved by 
 eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd 
El Gillil MDEPC quality control general manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Nageb inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes
Blower
Screw driver.
Megger (250-500 V)
Work to be 
carried out
Check power supply for each panel
Check circuit wiring
Measure the insulation resistance of control and alarm circuit.
Retighten the wiring and general cleaning by blower with small pressure.
Clean the bars and check coil by blower.
